title: Add event suppression conditions section to jmap-chat-wss-guide.md
description: jmap-chat-push-platform-guide.md has a clear 'When the server does not send a push' section listing suppression conditions clients must understand. jmap-chat-wss-guide.md has no equivalent. The receiveTypingIndicators suppression is buried in the server fan-out section; there is no client-facing summary of when events are silently dropped. Add a section listing when the server will not deliver ChatTypingEvent or ChatPresenceEvent to a given client: (1) receiveTypingIndicators is false for the recipient account, (2) the recipient is no longer a member of the chat at delivery time, (3) the sender is blocked by the recipient. Clients should not treat absence of events as evidence the conditions have changed.
